# CRANIAL EPIDURAL ABSCESS

Treatment involves source control by drainage procedure and antimicrobial

therapy.

Beta-lactam antibiotics are more effective than vancomycin against susceptible

Staphylococci. If Staphylococcus is isolated, once methicillin-resistance is

ruled out, switch to an anti-staphylococcal beta-lactam antibiotic. Pseudomonas

is a potential pathogen in post-surgical patients or patients with known

Pseudomonas colonization.

# Consult Neurosurgery, Neurology, and Infectious Disease

# Duration of Therapy

Treat for 6 weeks after surgical drainage. In patients with associated

osteomyelitis, patients in whom surgical drainage did not occur, and patients in

whom the response to therapy has been slow, treat for 6 to 8 weeks.

# Empiric Treatment

Preferred if Pseudomonas is not suspected:

[Ceftriaxone 2 gm IV q12h \($\) M <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h](orz-set-abx-ceftr-2gm-metro-500mg-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

($) [DI] <AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

Preferred if Pseudomonas is suspected:

[Cefepime 2gm IV Q8h \($$\) R <AND> metronidazole 500 mg IV q8h \($\) DI](orz-set-abx-cefe2gmivq8h-metro500mgivq8h-vanco15mg-kgivq12hstat)

<AND> vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h ($) [R]

Alternative:

[Assessment of beta-lactam reaction](orz-gtx-abx-beta-lactam-reaction-pdf)

[Meropenem 2 gm IV q8h \($$\) R,O <AND> vancomycin 15mg/kg IV q12h \($\) R](orz-set-abx-meropenem-2gm-iv-q8h-vanco-15mg-kg-iv-q12h)

# Treatment if methicillin-sensitive S. aureus is isolated

[Nafcillin 2 gm IV q4h \($$\) R,DI](psjizid-nafcillin-2gm-iv-q4h)

< OR >

[Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h \($\) R](psjizid-cefazolin-2gm-ivpb-q8h)
